encoding/single_byte#

Immutable ASCII and ISO-8859-1 codecs.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

AsciiEncoded(origin: "hello").bytes();
// [104, 101, 108, 108, 111]

Latin1Decoded(origin: [byte(99), byte(97), byte(102), byte(233)])
    .string();
// "café"

Description#

Immutable ASCII and ISO-8859-1 codecs.

Latin-1 means ISO-8859-1 exactly, never Windows-1252 or a locale-selected code page. Consequently every byte decodes, including 0x80..0x9F as the corresponding Unicode control characters.

Encoding errors report a Unicode-scalar offset in the source string. An ASCII decoding error reports a byte offset. Codecs never replace, skip, normalize or transliterate values.
